statements.statement: The member has a documented history of recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent syncope
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) was ordered
The monitoring is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying cardiac rhythm disturbances for ambulatory evaluation
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and R55
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
